reason: A ComfyUI integration plugin that exposes contract-based tools for scanning workflows, validating models and nodes, submitting media-generation jobs, and managing resulting local outputs.

summaries.zh: 通过合同化工具连接 ComfyUI，支持扫描和导入工作流、预检模型与节点、提交图像或视频生成任务并管理本地输出。
summaries.en: A ComfyUI integration that scans and imports workflows, preflights nodes and models, submits image or video generation jobs, and manages local outputs through contract-based tools.

capabilities: Connects to a ComfyUI HTTP server
Scans and imports local ComfyUI API-format workflow JSON
Submits text-to-image, image-to-image, text-to-video, and image-to-video generation jobs
Uploads or references local image, video, and audio inputs
Queries, waits for, and cancels generation jobs
Writes generated media and job records to configured directories
Manages a local LoRA registry and associated notes
